## Setting things up

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library("here")
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
base_url <- "http://userweb.eng.gla.ac.uk/umer.ijaz/bioinformatics/ecological/"
raw_data_path <- here("data/_raw/")

SPE <- read_csv(file = str_c(base_url, "SPE_pitlatrine.csv"))
write_csv(x = SPE,
          file = str_c(raw_data_path, "SPE_pitlatrine.csv"))

ENV <- read_csv(file = str_c(base_url, "ENV_pitlatrine.csv"))
write_csv(x = ENV,
          file = str_c(raw_data_path, "ENV_pitlatrine.csv"))
```

### What is data wrangling?

Data wrangling is the process of converting raw, messy data into a clean, structured, and usable format for analysis.

```{r}
#| eval: false
SPE |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -Taxa,
               names_to = "Samples",
               values_to = "OTU_Count")  |> 
  full_join(ENV, by = "Samples") |> 
  mutate(site = case_when(str_detect(Samples, "^T") ~ "Tanzania",
                          str_detect(Samples, "^V") ~ "Vietnam")) |>  
  write_tsv(file = here("data/SPE_ENV.tsv"))
```

### Read the data

```{r}
SPE_ENV <- read_tsv(file = here("data/SPE_ENV.tsv"))
SPE_ENV
```

### Task 7

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8

ggplot(data = SPE_ENV,
       mapping = aes(x = Taxa,
                     y = Samples,
                     fill = OTU_Count)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue",
                       high = "red",
                       mid = "white",
                       midpoint = 10000,
                       guide = "colourbar") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

### Task 8

```{r}
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}

taxa_of_interest <- c("Sphingobacteria", "Methanobacteria", "Clostridia",
                      "Anaerolineae", "Actinobacteria")

density_df <- SPE_ENV |>
  filter(Taxa %in% taxa_of_interest)

ggplot(data = density_df,
       mapping = aes(x = OTU_Count, y = Taxa, fill = Taxa)) +
  facet_wrap(~ site) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  labs(y = 'Taxa Identified',
       title = "OTU Count Distribution for 5 Taxa Stratified by Site",
       caption = "Data from doi.org/10.1111/1751-7915.12334") +
    theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### Task 9

```{r}
env_numeric <- ENV |>
  select(-Samples)

pca_result <- prcomp(env_numeric, scale. = TRUE)

variance_explained <- summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

pca_scores <- as_tibble(pca_result$x) |>
  mutate(Samples = ENV$Samples,
         site = if_else(str_starts(Samples, "T_"), "Tanzania", "Vietnam"))

ggplot(data = pca_scores,
       mapping = aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = site)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", round(variance_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(variance_explained[2], 1), "%)"),
       color = "Site",
       title = "PCA of environmental variables across samples") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom')
```
